answer: What survives to the island is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the atlas of a task receipt, and the river is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
